name: webconsulting/webcon-easy-workspace
description: Easy Workspace — a backend toolbar item for TYPO3 v14 that lets editors publish the current page (or news record) together with its content elements in one click.

suggest.georgringer/news: Adds news-bundle publishing (news record + content elements via tx_news_related_news).
suggest.friendsoftypo3/visual-editor: Enables the per-row eye icon to scroll & outline a content element inside the Visual Editor iframe. The dropdown works without it; the eye gracefully falls back to typo3/cms-viewpage's preview iframe.
